marketSummary: Indian equities extended their strong upward trajectory on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, with the Nifty 50 climbing above the 25,250 benchmark and the Sensex advancing over 770 points. The market undertone remains supported by sustained foreign institutional investor (FII) cash inflows exceeding ₹56,000 crore across an 8-session buying streak, complemented by resilience in auto, power, and railway counters ahead of the final leg of Q2 FY27 earnings.
dailyFocus: Breakout traders should focus on post-earnings trend continuations in Auto and Power, while monitoring high-volume volatility adjustments in Defence following divergent prints between BEL's fresh order intake and Cochin Shipyard's sharp margin compression. Keep HAL and RVNL on tight watch ahead of their November 12 earnings disclosures.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Q2 PAT Plunges 50% to ₹53.8 Cr on Shipbuilding Segment Loss; Declares ₹3 Interim Dividend
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard reported a 50% year-on-year drop in consolidated net profit to ₹53.77 crore for Q2 FY27, despite an 11.7% rise in revenue to ₹1,249.19 crore. Profitability was severely hampered by a loss of ₹6.08 crore in its shipbuilding division and total expense growth of 15%. The company declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per share with a record date of November 16, 2026.
news.impact: Distribution breakdown through ₹1,250 support invalidates near-term cup-and-handle setups and triggers a multi-session corrective wave.

news.headline: Tata Power Convenes Board Meeting on Nov 11 to Consider Q2 Results; Street Anticipates Top-Line Expansion
news.summary: Tata Power Company reports its second-quarter earnings on November 11, 2026. Brokerages project revenue growth of up to 26-28% YoY to approximately ₹19,570-20,167 crore, driven by full operationalization of the Mundra UMPP under Section 11 and ongoing capacity commissioning in renewable generation.
news.impact: Testing multi-month base floor near ₹355-₹360; volume response to earnings print will confirm whether a swing reversal or further breakdown ensues.

news.headline: HAL Convenes Board Meeting on November 12 to Approve Q2 FY27 Financial Results
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd has scheduled its board meeting for Thursday, November 12, 2026, to review and approve audited Q2 FY27 results. The market is eyeing order execution updates on the Tejas Mk1A delivery schedule and progress on indigenous aero-engine joint ventures.
news.impact: Volatility contraction pattern just under ₹5,130 resistance sets up a high-probability post-earnings directional breakout.

news.headline: Ashoka Buildcon Rallies 14% on Securing ₹865.9 Crore NHAI Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway Contract
news.summary: Ashoka Buildcon received a formal Letter of Acceptance from NHAI for the balance construction work of the 8-lane Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway (Karvad to Jujuwa section in Gujarat) valued at ₹865.90 crore on an EPC basis with an 18-month timeline. The announcement triggered strong institutional accumulation, sending the counter up 14% intraday.
news.impact: High-volume stage-1 base breakout above ₹110 with elevated volume expansion signals potential multi-week trend reversal.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Fresh Orders Worth ₹909 Crore Following Strong Q2 Outperformance
news.summary: Navratna defence PSU Bharat Electronics announced additional order inflows of ₹909 crore across navigation systems, optronic pedestals, and communications hardware. This builds upon its solid Q2 FY27 results where revenue grew 26.5% YoY to ₹7,291 crore and net profit climbed 19.8% to ₹1,541 crore, keeping the order book elevated at ₹68,717 crore.
news.impact: Sustained order accretion reinforces cup-and-handle breakout structure above ₹395 with defensive support on pullbacks.

news.headline: Mahindra & Mahindra Surges 5% as Q2 Consolidated Net Profit Jumps 25% to ₹4,588 Crore
news.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra reported robust Q2 FY27 consolidated earnings with net profit advancing 25% YoY to ₹4,588 crore and operational revenue up 25% to ₹57,553 crore. Growth was led by the automotive segment, which registered a 55% jump in PAT and an SUV revenue market share of 24.3%, triggering fresh buying across auto names.
news.impact: Decisive gap-up continuation above former resistance establishes institutional leadership and invalidates overhead consolidation supply.

news.headline: Trent Formalises Leadership Transition as Noel Tata Steps Down on Nov 11, Succeeded by Bahram Vakil
news.summary: Tata Group retail major Trent announced that Noel N. Tata retires as Chairman on November 11, 2026, transitioning to Chairman Emeritus on November 12, with Senior Corporate Lawyer Bahram N. Vakil appointed Chairman. The transition comes as Trent maintains momentum post Q2 FY27 results, where consolidated net profit rose 25.3% to ₹468 crore alongside opening its 1,000th Zudio store.
news.impact: Calm price absorption above ₹3,000 support signals institutional confidence in succession, maintaining a tight consolidation shelf.

news.headline: Rail Vikas Nigam Reschedules Q2 FY27 Results to Nov 12 as Railway Stocks Surge Up to 9%
news.summary: RVNL informed exchanges that its board meeting to approve Q2 FY27 standalone and consolidated financial results has been advanced to November 12, 2026. Railway shares experienced broad buying interest on November 11, with RVNL rallying over 6-9% intraday to surpass ₹215 on significant trading volumes.
news.impact: High-volume rebound off key moving averages sets up an aggressive pre-earnings breakout attempt toward the ₹225 swing level.

news.headline: FIIs Inject ₹56,770 Crore Over 8-Day Inflow Run, Propelling Nifty Above 25,250
news.summary: Foreign portfolio investors extended their sustained buying streak in Indian equities, registering cumulative inflows of ₹56,771 crore across 8 consecutive sessions. The liquidity push powered benchmark Nifty 50 above 25,250 and Sensex beyond 81,800, creating broad-market tailwinds for large-cap swing setups.
news.impact: Persistent institutional liquidity expands market breadth and elevates win rates for primary base breakouts across leading sectors.

news.headline: Eicher Motors Schedules Q2 FY27 Board Meeting for Nov 13 with Royal Enfield Volumes Up 16%
news.summary: Eicher Motors will consider and approve Q2 FY27 financial results on Friday, November 13, 2026. Prior quarterly operational metrics showed Royal Enfield motorcycle sales rose 16% YoY to 3,78,669 units, while commercial vehicle JV VECV recorded a 28.2% sales increase.
news.impact: Ascending base formation on constructive volume anticipates earnings delivery; watch for an upside breakout through recent pivot highs.

news.headline: CG Power Reviews Pollution Control Directive on Waluj Unit as Operations Backed by Strong Q2 Margins
news.summary: CG Power disclosed receiving a closure directive from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board for its Waluj, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar manufacturing unit under the Water and Air Acts. The company stated the financial impact is not immediately ascertainable and is taking legal steps. This comes on the heels of a 44% YoY jump in Q2 FY27 PAT to ₹409 crore and board approval for capacity expansion.
news.impact: Price compression between ₹800 support and ₹840 resistance creates an overhead supply ceiling pending regulatory resolution.
